high_level_description: The image features one person, a woman, standing in the foreground. She has long, dark hair that falls over her shoulders. She is wearing traditional attire, which appears to be a salwar kameez or similar outfit: The top (kameez) is light pink with intricate embroidery in gold and darker tones, featuring floral and geometric patterns. The bottom (salwar) is white, also adorned with subtle embroidery. She is accessorized with large, dangling earrings and a bracelet on her right wrist. Furniture: There are several outdoor tables and chairs in the background.
